project.description: This job needs a refactor. Should just be determining if it's in the new metadata.json format or the older version. Do the JQ transform to the new format more transparent and simpler.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail
# Assume dbgap-etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
# Export temporary credentials export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g")
# Download payload from S3 aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/facet_loader_configuration.json" "./facet_loader_configuration.json" --no-progress
# Clean credentials unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
PAYLOAD_FILE="./facet_loader_configuration.json" echo "Using facet loader payload: ${PAYLOAD_FILE}"
# Validate JSON if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then if ! jq empty "${PAYLOAD_FILE}" 2>/dev/null; then echo "ERROR: Payload file is not valid JSON: ${PAYLOAD_FILE}" >&2 exit 1 fi fi
# Run facet loader HTTP_CODE=$(curl --silent --show-error --fail \ --retry 10 \ --retry-delay 5 \ --retry-all-errors \ --retry-connrefused \ -o facet_loader_response.json \ -w "%{http_code}" \ -X POST \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data-binary @"${PAYLOAD_FILE}" \ ${api}/facet/loader/load)
echo "Facet loader response (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE}):" cat facet_loader_response.json || true
# Re-export credentials for upload export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g")
# Upload response to S3 aws s3 cp "facet_loader_response.json" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/facet_loader_response.json" --no-progress
# Clean credentials again unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
# --- New recover months generation step --- echo "Triggering RECOVER months facet generation..." cat > recover_months_payload.json <<'EOF' { "dryRun": false } EOF
HTTP_CODE_RECOVER=$(curl --silent --show-error --fail \ --retry 10 \ --retry-delay 5 \ --retry-all-errors \ --retry-connrefused \ --max-time 0 \ -o recover_months_response.json \ -w "%{http_code}" \ -X POST \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data-binary @recover_months_payload.json \ ${api}/facet/loader/recover/months/generate)
echo "Recover months generation response (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE_RECOVER}):" cat recover_months_response.json || true
# Upload recover months response export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g")
aws s3 cp "recover_months_response.json" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/recover_months_response.json" --no-progress
# Final cleanup unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
echo "Job completed successfully."
